decision.scope: trusted server-derived actor/ownership scope + allowlisted operation + operationKey
decision.storedBinding: normalized per-operation payload digest + original command result
decision.transactionBoundary: idempotency claim + business write + original result in the same transaction
decision.idEncodingRationale: 固定ID编码和版本规则依赖已定义的服务端范围、操作白名单及载荷等价规则；当前只记录持久化策略，不猜测编码格式。

reuseSurvey.projectCode: packages/shared/src/contracts/idempotency.ts provides the replay-or-reject decision after server-side payload comparison; it does not implement lookup, persistence, transactions, or recovery.

officialSources.finding: CloudBase database add accepts data and can use a specified document ID; this is API capability evidence, not concurrent idempotency proof.
DATABASE_DUPLICATE_WRITE describes a duplicate indexed key, including a duplicate document ID; exact error handling still needs runtime verification.
Document database transactions run server-side through Node SDK; transaction operations include add and have a 10-second maximum.
